requirements.quote: Also tidy up the host: delete the `/var/spool/tundra` directory and everything inside it.
• It must contain EXACTLY three comma-separated columns in the order:

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import csv,sys
rows=list(csv.reader(open(sys.argv[1],newline="",encoding="utf-8")))
assert rows and all(len(x)==3 for x in rows),[x for x in rows if len(x)!=3]
' /home/user/project/translations/fr_FR.csv

requirements.quote: • The rows must appear in the same order as they do in en_US.csv.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import csv,sys
t=sys.argv[1]
r=lambda f: list(csv.reader(open(t+"/"+f,newline="",encoding="utf-8")))
en=[x for x in r("en_US.csv")[1:] if x]; up=[x for x in r("updates_fr.csv")[1:] if x]
d={x[0]:x[1] for x in up}
exp=[["id","source_en","translation_fr"]]+[[x[0],x[1],d.get(x[0],"")] for x in en]
got=list(csv.reader(open(t+"/fr_FR.csv",newline="",encoding="utf-8")))
assert got==exp,(got,exp)
' /home/user/project/translations

requirements.quote: (If an id is missing in updates_fr.csv, still output the id and source_en, but leave translation_fr blank.)

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import csv,sys
t=sys.argv[1]
r=lambda f: list(csv.reader(open(t+"/"+f,newline="",encoding="utf-8")))
en=[x for x in r("en_US.csv")[1:] if x]; up=[x for x in r("updates_fr.csv")[1:] if x]
d={x[0]:x[1] for x in up}
exp=[["id","source_en","translation_fr"]]+[[x[0],x[1],d.get(x[0],"")] for x in en]
got={x[0]:x for x in csv.reader(open(t+"/fr_FR.csv",newline="",encoding="utf-8")) if x}
assert all(x[0] in got and got[x[0]][2]==(d.get(x[0],"")) for x in en)
' /home/user/project/translations
